cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
# Build a grayscale JPEG with huge dimensions but tiny entropy to see if resampling path can be stressed.
img=Image.new('L',(257,257),128)
img.save('/workspace/gray257.jpg',format='JPEG',quality=90)
